name: Weberhof
beschreibung: The Weberhof is located at the entrance to Brixen im Thale, directly on the access road to the Brixental. The house has a traditional feel with a high proportion of wood inside; the furnishings are simple and functional. Guests can expect traditional Tiroler Küche with regional products and a cozy parlour where locals and holidaymakers meet. Parking spaces are located directly at the house.
